description:
The flag exchange with the Rotary Club of Shillong Heritage, was held at the Marriott Shillong on 26th September at 10 am.
Our President Amit Gupta exchanged the flag with President Anupam Choudhary of Shillong Heritage in the presence of 40 members of Bombay Pier.
